summary.text: Dawn Euer is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 13 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Euer was assigned to the Senate Judiciary Committee (as chair), Special Legislation and Veterans' Affairs, and the Rules, Government Ethics and Oversight Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
In the 2021-2022 session she chaired the Environment and Agriculture Committee.
Euer defeated Angela Lima in the September 9, 2026 Democratic primary for District 13, 2,634 votes (67.4%) to 1,273 (32.6%).
Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate on the November 3 general election ballot.
